A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Spaced KD research. All 18 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A.1–A.10, support comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-classification experiments, ablations, and robustness evaluations in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and reports revised KD-method comparisons and additional self-KD corruption results.

M1.justification: The teacher-ahead training and frozen-teacher distillation procedure in Section 4.1, its objectives, and Algorithms 1–4 are unchanged. The new compatibility comparisons do not document a revision to Spaced KD itself.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet-100, and ImageNet-1K, including the same image-corruption and BIM attack scenarios. The revised experiments use existing datasets and input conditions.

E2.justification: Table 4 replaces BAN, TAKD, DML, SHAKE, DLB, and PSKD with TSB, CTKD, and LSKD, substantially revising the compatibility comparison. The old methods retain implementation discussion in Appendix A.3 but lose their reported comparison results. Table 5 also adds spaced versus unspaced self-KD comparisons.

E3.justification: Table 4 expands from CIFAR-100/ResNet-18 to four configurations combining CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet with ResNet-18 and DeiT-Tiny. Table 5 extends corruption evaluation to self KD. Existing training recipes, accuracy metrics, and corruption conditions remain unchanged; additional baseline-specific settings are not supplied.

E4.justification: Table 5 adds self-KD robustness evidence for six severity-1 image corruptions across ResNet-18/50/101. The spacing, timing, loss-function, learning-rate/batch-size, parameter-noise, and BIM analyses otherwise retain their existing evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions state that results are averaged over three repeats. No new run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is introduced.

E6.justification: Table 4 replaces the six earlier method comparisons with new TSB/CTKD/LSKD results across four configurations; for example, CIFAR-100/ResNet-18 TSB scores are 71.70% without spacing and 72.82% with spacing. Table 5 adds self-KD results, including 50.65% versus 60.57% under impulse noise for ResNet-18. Existing online-KD corruption values and Tables 1–3 and 6–13 are unchanged. Section 5.3 additionally asserts learning-rate effectiveness for self KD, although Figure 5 is unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 4.2 retains the same assumptions, Definitions 4.1–4.2, Lemma 4.3, Theorem 4.4, and Hessian derivation. The proof in Appendix A.1 is unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions: biologically inspired spacing improves online and self KD, connects to flatter minima, and applies across architectures and KD methods. The added experiments support existing claims.

C2.justification: The explanations involving teacher stability, flatter minima, and late-training effectiveness are retained. The conclusion preserves the same limitations concerning optimal spacing, adaptive interval selection, and distillation timing.

D1.justification: v2 newly announces released code and provides a repository address in the abstract. Hyperparameters and pseudocode remain unchanged. Appendix A.3 still documents the replaced Table 4 methods and provides no corresponding implementation update for the new comparisons.

R1.justification: v2 adds references for temporal-spatial boosting and curriculum-temperature KD and describes these methods alongside LSKD in Section 5.2. The LSKD reference was already present in v1. The broader related-work discussion and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: The Different KD Methods paragraph is rewritten, a code-access sentence and acknowledgments are added, and affiliations, correspondence, and publication information are updated. The section organization and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 4 is reorganized into dataset/model groups with method columns; Table 5 gains a KD-method column and self-KD block. Table 2 moves from page 7 to page 6, with associated text reflow. All six figures retain their contents, and appendix pages are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The new self-KD corruption tests address a previously untested part of the robustness claim, while Table 4 extends compatibility evidence across CNN and transformer configurations. Code-access information adds practical value. These gains are limited by losing the six earlier comparisons and leaving Appendix A.3 and Table 4's caption inconsistent with the replacement results. The net improvement is modest; the method and theory are unchanged.
